thread:
Maria (Design): quick UX/opinion check — I'm prototyping a `Normalize Y` toggle for charts with multiple series + switching to a colorblind-safe palette. mock: https://figma.com/proto/rwd/chart-normalize (ignore real link)
Lee (Product): hmm — are you thinking normalize per visible time window or across the whole series history?
Maria (Design): per-visible-window by default. option to persist normalization for comparison.
Josh (Data Viz): +1 for per-window. Also: if we normalize, we should change tooltip copy to say `values normalized to view` — avoids confusion.
Sarah (Accessibility): colour palette is good, but we should offer pattern fills or dashed lines for people who can't distinguish hues. Also check contrast ratios for small legend text.
Evan (Frontend): pattern fills are doable but will increase SVG complexity. alternative: add a "high-contrast mode" toggle that switches legend text and strokes to thicker weights.
Maria (Design): example color swatches I'm proposing:
```
--rwd-cb-1: #0072B2;
--rwd-cb-2: #D55E00;
--rwd-cb-3: #E69F00;
--rwd-cb-4: #009E73;
```
Josh (Data Viz): those are the usual CB-safe ones, looks fine. For overlapped series, we could add slight translucency or offset lines so patterns don't fully occlude.
Lee (Product): small UX Q: should `Normalize Y` be global per dashboard or per-chart? I lean per-chart with a tooltip linking to docs on how normalization affects aggregates.
Maria (Design): per-chart makes sense. we'll add a compact badge in the chart header: `Normalized` with hover tooltip.
Evan (Frontend): outlier handling note — if we normalize and there are extreme spikes, normalized curves flatten and hide trends. Suggest a small control: `Cap outliers at percentile` default 99.5. config: `yAxis.maxStrategy: "percentile:99.5"`.
Sarah (Accessibility): tiny copy nits: in the toggle label avoid jargon. Use `Normalize Y (scale to view)` instead of just `Normalize`.
Josh (Data Viz): agree on copy. Also add a tiny helper in tooltip: original units shown in parenthesis, e.g., `12.3 (orig: 12000 req/s)`.
Maria (Design): will update Figma and handoff. Evan — could you prototype pattern-fill toggle and the percentile cap control in a small PR? I'll write the copy changes and tooltip text.
Evan (Frontend): yep. I'll spin up a prototype branch. ping me in #eng-releases if you want a quick demo deploy.
Maria (Design): thanks all. tagging accessibility checklist: @Sarah (Accessibility) please confirm once pattern fills & legend contrast pass.
Sarah (Accessibility): will review. quick checklist: focus order, legend keyboard targets, pattern visibility at 1x and 1.5x zoom, color contrast. I'll reply with checklist items.
design-bot: Reminder: file the UI changes in the "charting patterns" RFC before shipping so analytics and product know the change.
Maria (Design): noted — I'll open RFC after the prototype. :thumbsup:
